title: SHAP
description: Documented public model explanation method (Lundberg & Lee (open source)) for the Model Interpretability Workbench capability area.
body:
SHAP is a documented model explanation method from Lundberg & Lee (open source). SHapley Additive exPlanations: game-theoretic feature attributions that became the standard for explaining model predictions.

How it works: It works by shuffling each feature in turn, measuring the accuracy drop, and ranking features by their permutation importance.

Documented uses of this capability area include neural architecture search, automated hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation leaderboards, and AI safety red-teaming.
